title: Admin Dashboard: Build a Start Page for Your Editors | Orchard Core
description:
The home page of the Orchard Core admin shows a welcome message and a few shortcuts. Your team may need its own links, notes, and reminders on that page.

The Admin Dashboard module replaces it with widgets. Each widget is a content item that you create, publish, place and size on a grid, and permissions decide who sees the dashboard and its widgets.

In this video:
• How the dashboard works: widgets, grid cells and published content
• Enable the dashboard
• Add a widget
• Arrange and manage widgets: drag, resize, and use the Actions menu
• Who sees the dashboard: two permissions and the right to view a widget
• Your own widget types
